test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who travels on foot.
solution:
The correct answer is **"pedestrian"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Dweller- **a person who lives in a city, town, cave, etc.
 
• **Flyer- **a small piece of paper with information on it about a product or event, a person who flies a plane, or a person who travels in a plane as a passenger.
 
• **Rover- **a person who spends their time traveling from place to place
 
• **Pedestrian- **a person who is walking, especially in an area where vehicles go.
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. Pedestrian.**
